note: getParadoxSpellpower(self,t) = combatSpellpower(mod*pm) with mod=1 and pm=getParadoxModifier(self)=bound(sqrt(paradox/300),0.5,1.5) (chronomancer.lua:154, 183); info other.lua:118 calls it for 「时空法术强度」. Title pins paradox 300 -> pm=1, so the ladder equals the 法术强度 ladder.

getModifiedParadox (Actor.lua:5378) returns will_modifier = 2*(self:getWil() + (self:attr("paradox_reduce_anomalies") or 0)); info prints it as 「意志修正数值：-%d」 (other.lua:127), so the value is -will_modifier. paradox_reduce_anomalies is an equipment/talent attribute the export does not set -> frozen at 0.

getModifiedParadox (Actor.lua:5378) returns modified_paradox = math.max(0, self:getParadox() - will_modifier + sustain_modifier); info prints it as 「修正后紊乱值」 (other.lua:129). will_modifier = 2*wil (paradox_reduce_anomalies -> 0), sustain_modifier = self:getMinParadox() = 0 because the export actor sustains nothing.
